title: How does steering strength trade off against general capability degradation for safety concepts?

original_idea.body: For ~4 safety concepts, sweep steering coefficient measuring target safety change and general capability (MMLU/GSM8K subset, perplexity), and plot the safety-gain vs capability-cost frontier.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: safety-vs-capability frontier guides operators, but link skips a step.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Partly covered by 'Steering without Sacrifice'/PrOSV; some external slice remains.

novelty.reasoning: Tradeoffs studied; per-concept frontier may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Per-safety-concept frontier may be partly open.
